worker_terminal_note: The reported validation failure was caused by pytest being unavailable under sanitized HOME; the standalone taskdb/taskctl suite passes 15/15 on the parent host.
accepted_findings: The callback outbox currently deduplicates terminal wakes by task, transition, origin thread and claim episode.
A genuinely distinct launch identity must participate in callback idempotence so same-launch retries deduplicate while a new launch can wake again.
The proposed request_id-widened database migration is a useful candidate and requires a fully authorized launch-path binding.
rejection_reasons: ProcessManager treats launch-request binding as best-effort and continues launching after binding fails, so the original callback-loss bug remains possible.
The candidate deliberately omits runner/topic when calling core.run_taskctl, bypassing RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST instead of extending the exact authority contract.
Its MCP tests assert both fail-open behavior and the allowlist bypass, so passing those tests does not satisfy the production safety contract.
